name: Find and Replace Text
description: Find and replace text with support for regular expressions and capture groups, case sensitivity, whole-word matching, and replace-first vs. replace-all.

faq.question: How do I use capture groups?
faq.answer: Enable "Use regular expression", wrap the parts of your pattern you want to reuse in parentheses, then reference them in the replacement as $1, $2, and so on in order. For example, (\d+)-(\d+)-(\d+) replaced with $2/$3/$1 turns a YYYY-MM-DD date into MM/DD/YYYY.

faq.question: What does "whole word only" do?
faq.answer: It wraps your search pattern in word boundaries (\b), so searching for "cat" matches the standalone word "cat" but not the "cat" inside "catalog" — useful when a short search term would otherwise match unwanted substrings of longer words.
